title: Anti-paper leak bill clears Parliament; PM Modi says it will build a credible exam system
content: Parliament approved a bill to amend the anti-paper leak law. This legislation introduces stricter punishments for individuals involved in exam malpractices. Prime Minister Modi stated this is a crucial step for a credible exam system. The bill proposes significant jail terms and substantial fines for offenders. It also empowers governments to establish special fast-track courts for these cases.

title: DoS, Isro launch major hiring drive for 746 posts, 92 will be scientist/engineers
content: Isro and DoS have initiated a significant recruitment drive for 746 positions.  These openings include regular posts and apprenticeship opportunities for future talent.  The drive aims to address a notable vacancy rate within the space department.  Administrative roles and scientist/engineer positions are being filled across various centers.  This effort seeks to bolster Isro's workforce and operational capabilities.

title: Liti's 223kg stunner denies Lovepreet CWG gold by 1kg in weightlifting
content: Liti produced a Commonwealth Games record lift of 223kg in the clean and jerk to move ahead of the Indian and win gold with a total of 389kg, just one kilogram more than Lovepreet. Liti had lifted 166kg in the snatch.

title: Supreme Court: No blanket ban on use of pellet guns for crowd control
content: The Supreme Court ordered the Delhi government to treat all injured protesters.  It questioned the feasibility of banning pellet guns for crowd control.  The court directed the preservation of ammunition logs for effective investigation.  It also emphasized the need for police to have adequate safety gear.  The bench reiterated that peaceful protests can sometimes be hijacked by miscreants.

title: NYC banned Motoclick, now Mamdani targets Uber Eats, DoorDash over "hidden" tip buttons
content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city's crackdown on Uber Eats and DoorDash tipping practices has delivered $104 million in extra tips to delivery workers since January. A new DCWP report shows tips per delivery doubled from $1.18 to $2.29 after apps were forced to show tip buttons at checkout. Mamdani, who earlier moved to shut down Motoclick, warns more enforcement is coming.

title: 16 Indians, including 10 seamen, killed in Middle East conflict: Government
content: Sixteen Indian nationals, including ten seafarers, have died in the West Asia conflict. Seventy-five other Indian nationals sustained injuries in the same regional conflict. In a separate incident, twelve Indian nationals perished at Qatar's Ras Laffan Gas Facility. The government is coordinating with host nations to repatriate mortal remains. Injured individuals received medical treatment and necessary assistance from Indian missions.

title: Release 3,500 cusecs of water to Tamil Nadu: Cauvery authority to Karnataka
content: The Cauvery Water Management Authority ordered Karnataka to release 3,500 cusecs daily. This directive mandates a total release of 4 TMC of water to Tamil Nadu. Karnataka had appealed the committee's order citing low reservoir levels and drought conditions. State officials stated reservoir levels were significantly lower than last year. Tamil Nadu representatives argued against Karnataka's plea, citing sufficient flow.

title: From 617 to 2,000 in 2025, Indians deported from US triple since 2023
content: Four hundred fourteen Indians faced deportation from the US by March 2026. Deportations from the US significantly increased from 2023 to 2025. The United Kingdom and Cyprus also deported Indians, with fifty-seven and fifty-three respectively. Government data shows thousands of unregistered agents were notified on the eMigrate portal. Indian truckers arrested in Arizona are also facing deportation proceedings.

title: Kevin O'Leary says China's rise will unite US, Canada and Mexico
content: Kevin O'Leary suggests China's growing power will unite North American economies.  Canada offers minerals and energy, while the US provides scale and innovation.  Mexico also plays a vital role in the regional economic landscape.  Companies are increasingly using cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models.  This shift occurs as the race for technological dominance accelerates globally.

title: Middle East conflict: PM Modi reviews safety of seafarers, supply chain constraints
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired a special security meeting concerning the West Asia crisis.  He directed the establishment of a mechanism to aid seafarers and their families.  Discussions also covered ensuring uninterrupted fertilizer supply for the upcoming rabi season.  The government's strategy to diversify energy sources has mitigated risks effectively.  A whole-of-government approach is being continued to safeguard citizens' interests.

title: 13-year-old turns peanut shells into pesticide remover, eyes $25k prize
content: Thirteen-year-old Minnesota student Arika Kundu has designed a method that uses discarded peanut shells to help remove pesticide residues from fresh fruits and vegetables. Her project, called LIGNEX, has made her one of 10 finalists in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge. She will now compete for the $25,000 grand prize with guidance from a 3M scientist.

title: Florida sixth-grader makes soil balls to save water, eyes $25,000 prize
content: An 11-year-old Florida student has reached the finals of a national science competition.  Her innovative soilshade balls help farmers conserve water during dry weather conditions.  This eco-friendly invention slows evaporation and keeps soil moist for extended periods.  She will compete for a $25,000 prize and mentorship from 3M scientists.  The competition celebrates young innovators using STEM to solve real-world problems.

title: Viral Nausicaä radar domes video: Crew look insect-sized on $500m yacht
content: Yusaku Maezawa's superyacht Nausicaä is drawing attention for its large satellite equipment. This 374-foot vessel was designed by Marc Newson, known for his Apple Watch work. The yacht's massive domes are radomes protecting delicate satellite receivers from the marine environment. Nausicaä functions as a high-tech floating resort, supporting many guests and crew members. It utilizes advanced propulsion and satellite links for operational data transmission.

title: Parliament passes Vande Mataram bill
content: Parliament passed the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Bill on Thursday. This amendment extends legal protection to the national song Vande Mataram. The DMK opposed the bill, citing concerns about national division and imposition. The BJP defended the amendment, emphasizing respect for the complete Vande Mataram song. This action places Vande Mataram on par with the national anthem for legal protection.

title: 215 academicians slam Priyanka for 'gaumutra' remark
content: Over two hundred academicians have written an open letter criticizing Priyanka Gandhi Vadra's remark. They stated that dismissing scholars with labels undermines the nation's scientific temper. The academicians defended the IIT Madras director's advocacy of cow urine's potential benefits. They emphasized that scientific temper involves objective examination of claims before acceptance. Mockery is not a substitute for reasoned engagement in public debate, they added.

title: Ukraine dials India, seeks peace role amid ship attack concerns

He reiterated India's stance that such attacks are unacceptable and unequivocally condemned. The minister also highlighted the global impact of multiple conflicts on security. Ukraine's representative briefed him on recent developments and peace efforts. India consistently advocates for dialogue and diplomacy to resolve conflicts.

title: How Kai Cenat became one of the world's biggest streamers
content: Kai Cenat’s rise began with comedy videos on Instagram before expanding to YouTube, joining AMP, and later becoming one of Twitch’s biggest stars. His success came through years of consistent work rather than one viral moment. Today, his personality, audience connection, and creative live streams have made him one of the most influential digital creators in the world.

title: Patriots, Chargers linked to $62M Buccaneers DT amid trade rumors
content: Vita Vea requested a trade from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after contract extension talks failed. New England Patriots and Los Angeles Chargers are top candidates for the 31-year-old defensive tackle at the moment. With the Patriots, he could form a Super Bowl-rich defensive front. With the Chargers, he could be a better disruptor than the current one.

title: Why Lamine Yamal says he can never repay his mother's sacrifices
content: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old World Cup winner, has spoken openly about a childhood shaped by financial hardship and parental sacrifice. His mother, Sheila Ebana, emigrated from Equatorial Guinea to Spain as a teenager, had Yamal at 16, and raised him largely alone after separating from his father when Lamine was three. Yamal credits her with shielding him from the worst of their circumstances, saying she made him see only the beautiful side of life. He also reflected on his rapid rise at Barcelona, describing himself as a creative and entertaining player who never anticipated reaching the first team quite so quickly

The company expressed regret and is examining the reasons behind the video's removal.  Government officials are scheduled to meet with Meta's global representatives soon.  Discussions will cover policy and technical aspects of the incident.

title: R Madhavan reveals why he relocated to Dubai for his son Vedant
content: R Madhavan had opened up about the real reason behind relocating to Dubai, revealing that the move was driven by his son Vedant's swimming career during the Covid-19 pandemic. The actor had also spoken about life in the UAE, why he believed there were "three Dubais," his enduring connection with India, and even his upcoming South Indian filter coffee venture.

title: Laid off after 10 years, Reddit user reveals how AI helped land a Rs 1.5 crore job
content: A professional secured a new job after an unexpected layoff and a lengthy search.  Artificial intelligence tools significantly aided interview preparation and response crafting.  The user pasted job descriptions and interviewer details into AI for tailored practice.  This strategic preparation led to a job offer with a substantial salary and benefits.  The experience highlights AI's evolving role in modern job seeking strategies.

title: BJP submits breach of privilege notice against Rahul Gandhi

BJP seeks an unconditional apology from the Congress leader.  The notice cites rules regarding defamatory allegations against individuals.  The matter has been sent to the privilege committee for inquiry.

title: J&K: Properties of 5 Pakistan-based terrorist handlers attached in Reasi
content: Jammu and Kashmir Police attached properties belonging to five Pakistan-based terrorist handlers in Reasi district. This action aims to prevent the misuse of these assets for terror financing activities. The attached land was linked to a case registered under stringent anti-terror laws. Investigations revealed the accused had exfiltrated to Pakistan for terrorist training and now operate as handlers.

title: 23 heritage sites in Ladakh declared protected monuments
content: Ladakh's Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena declared twenty-three heritage sites protected monuments. This initiative provides legal protection for Ladakh's rich archaeological and historical heritage. Sites in Leh and Kargil districts were notified as protected monuments under a specific act. The administration will now undertake conservation measures and prevent encroachments on these sites. This move reflects a commitment to preserving Ladakh's unique historical legacy for future generations.

title: 'Children's future won't be compromised': PM Modi hails anti-paper leak Bill in new video

This legislation aims to build a more trustworthy examination system across the nation. The government has taken continuous steps to improve examination processes and address paper leaks. This new law will ensure no paper leak mafia or gang playing with students' futures is spared.

title: CJP protest fallout: Noida woman booked over 'objectionable' remarks against PM Modi

The complaint was filed by Supreme Court advocate Smriti Singh after receiving several videos. The accused, Ruchika Singh, was identified and details were gathered by the complainant. Police registered the case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. The investigation has been transferred to Delhi Police for further proceedings.

title: US signs $58.6bn mega deal for Patriot missiles as stock runs low amid Iran war

This deal ensures long-term production of crucial air defence interceptors for the US Army.  Concerns over dwindling missile stockpiles influenced this major procurement decision.  The agreement aims to triple production capacity and boost employment at a key facility.  This expansion supports broader Pentagon efforts to accelerate weapons manufacturing globally.

Effort justification highlights how commitment increases the perceived value of an experience.  Travel should be about personal change and cultural understanding, not just convenience.  Authentic experiences and genuine connections define worthwhile journeys today.

Mayfield believes he is a franchise quarterback deserving of a higher salary.  He is entering the final year of his current contract with the team.  This situation creates significant pressure on the Buccaneers' front office.

content: The J&K government approved a gas agency for Insha Mushtaq eight years later. This rehabilitation pledge was approved on Thursday, reviving a commitment made in 2016. Insha lost her eyesight at fourteen after a pellet gun incident during protests. She has since learned Braille and is pursuing a bachelor's degree. The approval marks a significant turning point for her future.

The official brand identity 'Three Nations, One Heartbeat' symbolises unity among the co-hosts.
